value.rationale: The generators are exactly the two extremal equivalence classes in the new quartic classification. The result gives a natural complete subgroup-level invariant: an infinite rank-two abelian subgroup has sharp bounded quadratic-length spectrum {0,1,5}, with all nontrivial generator powers still extremal and a full cancellation diagonal of quadratic maps.
